EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No. : 11/3/3/1/14 I/1. Lands Ministry’s Ref. No. : LD/05/2008/MV/408E. I hereby give notice, under subsection (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired : Public purpose means the land Acquisition for the Development of Kaluganga South bank under the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below, containing in extent 0.1549 hectares shown in sheet No. 7, Zone No. 28 in C. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 09.00 a.m. on the 25th day of June, 2024 at the Laggala Divisional Secretariat.

And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of June, 2024, the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Swarna Perera, Divisional Secretary. At the Divisional Secretariat of Laggala, 29th February, 2024.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No. : 11/3/3/1/14 S. Lands Ministry’s Ref. No. : LD/05/2008/MV/408H. I hereby give notice, under sub section (1)of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired : Public purpose means the land Acquisition for the Development of Kaluganga South bank under the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below, containing in extent 1.5865 hectares shown in sheet No. 2, Zone No. 16 in C. P. 310243, approved by Surveyor General dated on 17.05.2023, situated at E 396 B Akarahediya Grama Niladhari Division of Laggala Pallesiya Pattuwa, Laggala Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central province:

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Bathalakotuwa, Asweddumekumbura, Lolugahaira, Kamathagawakumbura, Mailagawakumbura, Kandettamulakumbura, Wagaira, Kotteira; Description of Land: Paddy Field; Claimant : The State; Original Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent: 1.4523 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Welpitiya; Description of Land: Paddy Field; Claimant : The State; Original Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.1342 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 09.00 a.m. on the 25th day of June, 2024 at the Laggala Divisional Secretariat.

And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of June, 2024, the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Swarna Perera, Divisional Secretary. At the Divisional Secretariat of Laggala, 29th February, 2024.
